status: development defaults (NOT frozen); final master seeds and context list are fixed at the freeze (LR6)
source: plan v2.0 section 6 'Gemeinsame Defaults', sections 7, 11; plan change AE-01 (RK4)

content.write: theta(0) = phi * 1 + a * E u; E: four disjoint node pairs with +-1/sqrt(2)

measurement.addressing: per episode, node and readout time; shared between tasks on common nodes and between conditions

contexts.content: frequencies, location permutation, surrogate draw and all learning random sources

A.name: retention_v2
A.reference: the context's reference node (same as B)

B.name: remote_readout_v1
B.location_rule: per context a permutation of the 34 sorted IDs: first 8 = write nodes (4 pairs), next 9 = read nodes, the last of these 9 = reference

conditions.strength_surrogate: four-node switches from the original C keeping symmetry, zero diagonal, node strengths and [0,1]

controls.reset: state reset to phi * 1 right after the write

rules: one stream per episode and role (independent of batch size and order)
conditions share targets and measurement errors within a context
